name: SNAP (food help)
summary: Money on a card each month to buy groceries.
mightQualify: People with low or no income. Many people experiencing homelessness are eligible.
steps: Go to the Ohio Benefits website or your county job and family services office
Fill out the application. You can say you have no address or income
Watch your mail for your card

name: Medicaid (health care)
summary: Free or low-cost doctor visits, medicine and care.
mightQualify: Adults with low income. You can apply at the same time as SNAP.
steps: Apply on the Ohio Benefits website (same place as SNAP)
Answer questions about your household and income
Watch your mail for a decision and your card

name: Ohio State ID
summary: A photo ID card you need for jobs, banks and benefits.
mightQualify: Ohio residents. You'll need documents that prove who you are.
documents: Proof of address (a shelter letter may work)
steps: Gather your documents (see the ID step in your roadmap)
Get your photo taken and pay any fee (ask 211 about fee help)
